question_text: Which aircraft has right of way during overtaking?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The overtaking aircraft; the overtaken aircraft must give way.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Whichever aircraft is higher at the time.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The aircraft being overtaken; the overtaking aircraft keeps out of the way as prescribed.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Neither; both aircraft must alter course simultaneously.

explanation: The aircraft being overtaken; the overtaking aircraft keeps out of the way as prescribed.

incorrect_answer_explanations.A: This reverses the rule: the overtaken aircraft has right of way, the overtaking aircraft gives way.
incorrect_answer_explanations.B: Altitude is not the deciding factor in an overtaking situation.
incorrect_answer_explanations.D: Only the overtaking aircraft is required to manoeuvre; the overtaken aircraft maintains course.
